## 3. Flagship Engineering Projects & Architecture

### A. IOE Admission Hub (Admission Guide)
- **Live Canonical URL**: https://ioe-admission.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/
- **Portfolio Documentation**: https://www.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/projects/ioe-admission-guide
- **Description**: An educational analytics platform and admission cutoff forecaster built for Nepali high school graduates taking the Tribhuvan University Institute of Engineering (IOE) Entrance Examination.
- **Key Capabilities**: Historical cutoff trend analysis, campus quota allocation matrices (Pulchowk, Thapathali, WRC, ERC), and counseling priority planning.
- **Technology Stack**: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vercel edge deployment.

### B. Git Visualizer
- **Live Canonical URL**: https://git-visualizer.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/
- **Portfolio Documentation**: https://www.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/projects/git-visualizer
- **Description**: An interactive computer science pedagogical application designed to visually model Git version control DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) mechanics.
- **Key Capabilities**: Step-by-step commit tree animation, branch pointer transitions, merge conflict simulation, and command terminal emulation.
- **Technology Stack**: JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas/SVG, state graph simulation.

### C. Sportivo
- **Live Canonical URL**: https://sportivo.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/
- **Portfolio Documentation**: https://www.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/projects/sportivo
- **Description**: A responsive real-time sports discovery and match schedule tracking web platform with multi-server playback redundancy.
- **Key Capabilities**: Automated fixture polling, multi-source failover routing, and low-latency sports data caching.
- **Technology Stack**: Next.js, Node.js API endpoints, automated scraping worker pipelines.

### D. BeatMarker
- **Portfolio Documentation**: https://www.dipeshsapkota7.com.np/projects/beatmarker
- **Description**: Automation script and utility developed for Adobe After Effects that performs audio transient and beat detection to place keyframe markers programmatically.
